integrity.claim_basis: Exact reduction of the published Floquet dispersion relation followed by analytic boundary asymptotics; numerical bisection is only a replay check.
integrity.unproved_limits: No extension to nonsymmetric arc lengths, other fluxes, negative energy, or weighted density-of-states measures is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the symmetric tight chain \(\ell_1=0\), \(\ell_2=\ell_3=\pi\), half-integer flux, and fixed \(\ell>0\).
The measure is ordinary Lebesgue measure of the non-flat band set; no density-of-states weighting is claimed.
Flat-band momenta are isolated and therefore omitted without changing the measure asymptotics.
title: Logarithmic momentum length at the zero-density half-flux point
